The repository owner selected Apache-2.0 with Copyright 2026 zzzfu411. Root LICENSE/NOTICE, README and pyproject metadata are present; rebuilt wheel/sdist archives package all three declared license files and pass the strengthened offline distribution audit. License-focused acceptance passed 53 tests and the current secret scan checked 654 candidates.

Phase 6 now has a single source/wheel install, startup, configuration, upgrade, rollback and donor-deprecation runbook. The donor manifest marks stock_v2 as read-only evidence and never a runtime or release source; an executable preflight and five focused tests enforce the contract. The combined Phase 6 operations suite passed 57 tests and the secret scan checked 657 candidates.

Its focused status/release suite passed 50 tests and the secret scan checked 658 candidates.

Repository owner zzzfu411 completed the machine-readable release attestation on 2026-08-31: stock_v2 redistribution/relicensing rights, rotation of both donor-local credentials, and public disclosure of candidate b59affe plus attestation/release-evidence follow-ups were confirmed; no credential values are recorded. risks.title: Donor local configuration contains real LLM or MCP credentials
risks.closure: Repository owner zzzfu411 confirmed rotation of both donor-local credentials on 2026-08-31; no credential values are stored in release evidence.

risks.title: Live observations could contaminate research data or evidence
risks.closure: Independent append-only observation storage, explicit capture, tamper/recovery tests and negative promotion-boundary tests passed Phase 5.

risks.title: Trend plans or predictions could be interpreted as live trading instructions
risks.closure: Contract, API, OpenAPI and UI checks passed with research-only wording and no broker/order capability.

risks.title: Duplicate backtests or gates could issue contradictory promotion results
risks.closure: Canonical readiness remains the only gate authority; donor, LLM and observation promotion fields are stripped and negative tests passed Phase 5.

risks.title: Frontend integration progress could diverge from repository evidence
risks.closure: Status JSON is validated/projected read-only and Phase 5 evidence/status updates are committed with implementation and tests.

risks.title: Symbol and exchange normalization may diverge
risks.closure: Use canonical SymbolId and cross-market fixtures.

risks.title: Timezone, calendar, adjustment and suspension semantics may diverge
risks.closure: Publish a data dictionary and pass boundary fixtures.

risks.title: Stale provider cache may be displayed as real-time
risks.closure: Provider TTL and HIT/MISS/STALE reasons are explicit; complete visible freshness QA in the unified frontend before closing.

risks.title: SQLite locking and schema evolution may be unsafe
risks.closure: Separate storage roots, versioned records, concurrent append, tamper detection and independent-copy recovery tests passed.

risks.title: Python and Rust analysis may drift
risks.closure: Deterministic Python fallback and optional Rust parity fixtures passed with documented tolerances.

risks.title: File, URL or rich-text API surfaces may be exploitable
risks.closure: Report paths are allowlisted, traversal is rejected, no arbitrary proxy is exposed and packaged rich text uses DOMPurify; re-audit the versioned API and frontend before closing.

risks.title: Third-party web dependency notices may be incomplete
risks.closure: Bundled web dependencies have pinned versions, SHA-256 values, upstream sources, complete SPDX texts and automated archive verification.

risks.title: Donor runtime or build artifacts could leak into Git
risks.closure: Enforce denylist, ignore rules and staged artifact scans.

risks.title: Documentation or UI may overstate real-time capability
risks.closure: Capability matrix, fallback semantics and research-only wording are covered by the integrated frontend and contract tests; retain review through release rehearsal.
